hidden_patterns.H1_patterns_beat_volume: 12-15 patterns generalize to thousands of problems (Levelop 2026, Nexalgotrix 2026, Educative 2026). 75 deeply > 400 shallow.
hidden_patterns.H2_diagnose_first: PracHub 2026: diagnose with 3 unseen timed problems, repair largest gap only, re-validate. Completion != readiness.
hidden_patterns.H3_mock_early: Start mocks by week 4 even if unready; 5-8 mocks total; fatigue across rounds 3-4 is the dominant onsite failure (InterviewChamp 2026).
hidden_patterns.H4_ai_resistant_tail: System design + behavioral + live follow-ups are AI-resistant; coding alone is compressible by AI (TechInterview 2026, DeepEngineering 2026).
hidden_patterns.H5_ciu_gap: CIU excludes SQL/frontend/system-design-depth by design; senior loops require RESHADED + failure-mode + cost-tier reasoning (Aceloop 2026).

recommendation: Blind75 deeply (6-8 wks) for most; NeetCode150 (10-14 wks) for Google-L4+/quant; Grind75 adaptive for time-boxed.
